title: Crouching Father with Toddler Outdoors, 1947 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming post-World War II family snapshot from May 1947 capturing a father gently steadying his active 16-month-old toddler on a park path. The father wears wire-rimmed glasses, a small mustache, a light dress shirt, and dark trousers while crouching behind the child. The energetic child, caught mid-motion with arms outstretched, wears a striped shirt, cardigan, dark shorts, and white soft-soled shoes. In the background, lush shrubbery and a large columned pavilion or pergola frame the scene, reflecting typical mid-century domestic leisure.
